plan.selection: One allocator for all policies: total missed deadlines ascending; unfinished ascending; paired positive APmean harm vs WEIGHTED ascending; paired positive peak harm ascending; total API J ascending; WEIGHTED tie. Compare all DEV cells; no per-policy retuning.
plan.planner: Deterministic public-queue rollout, no sampled future progress. Request rank FIFO/EDF/existing ATC k2; same route selector; no voluntary WAIT in all arms. Forecast calls counted/capped separately.
plan.activity_ABI: Preserve all observed wall phase INFER/ADMISSION/POST features even where assumed CPU service is waiting or has finished; unallocated feature means only observed GAP/RETURN_GAP. These proxies are not CPU utilization. Server traces identify service/queue separately. Additional queue exposure and new pairs remain unvalidated transfer.
plan.calibration_selection: Primary architecture/ridge fixed before fitting measured data; no synthetic policy results used as regression targets. No post-EVAL retuning.

pure_forecast_memoization.key: Full public observation digest, frozen model and first nominal action; per-packet WeakMap identity
pure_forecast_memoization.equivalence: Deep equality against direct uncached forecast in pure tests; no actual environment/progress/sampling reuse

plan.numerical_integration: Midpoint AP with analytic within-step thermal state, bracketed earliest completion root; fixed active peer set per numerical step. Plant-private, never a policy observation.

planner: Deterministic event rollout of currently arrived public queue only, median phases/residuals, fixed held AP, real-slot capacities and shared CPU prefix server, FCFS CPU nonpreemption. Unknown owner remaining phase estimated from visible timestamps, not sampled progress. Actual plant AP feeds instantaneous work rates.
selector: Same route selector/thermal objective and information for FIFO/EDF/ATC. FIFO/EDF pick among slot-dispatchable requests, ATC k2. All are non-delay, voluntary WAIT=0. Frozen allocation choice is one global DEV choice, not per policy.
P0_gate: 36 paired .005/.0025 numerical cases: identical completion/on-time counts; abs J diff<.2J and APmean diff<.01C. Independent stored activity/cost/rate/input audit of72 before DEV.
completion: All3240 terminal receipts + independent complete artifact/activity/cost/work/input/action replay + DEV freeze chronology/coverage/accounting + full losses/conditional CI and model reversals + browser QA + docs/GitHub
measurement_scope: API unit-hypothesis energy and HAL AP empirical predictions, not independent phone energy/skin validation
